text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Who did you vote for in the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Chrono Genesis!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"She's been so amazing lately.
I don't think she's missed the board once."

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
I really love her column, you know?
She writes about history and the connections between the girls,
so even a casual fan like me can really feel moved by it—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
The data is mostly compiled now.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I've secured the data on the key contenders for the Representative Exchange Race.
Analyzing these should reveal the likely race patterns on the day.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... the representative exchange race Umamusume
closest to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: “<chrname>”。

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...
I need to go get changed soon.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo, hoo...
Phew, nnngh...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
One more time――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Chrono Genesis-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
T-Tazuna-san.
Good evening.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt your intense training session.
...It's almost time to turn off the lights.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I-I'm sorry.
I'll head back right away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, take your time, it's okay.
...The representative exhibition matches are coming up soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
...It's full of formidable competitors.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, you haven't given up, have you?
Because seeing you train,
you were the very picture of determination.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...
Yes, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Back when I first joined Project L'Arc,
all I could think about was desperately wanting
to help conquer the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: For me to wish for a maiden victory... felt like nothing more than a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However,
as I ran in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Chronooo!!
Thank you for an incredible race!
I'm definitely voting for you in the next fan poll!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Good luck on your challenge at the Arc~! You're definitely gonna become number one in the world!!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was given...
so much courage.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I've started to feel that maybe this dream is within my grasp after all...
That maybe these legs really can carry me past that finish line."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I want to be part of making history.
There, on the soil of France.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Those feelings
have surely reached all your fans as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you ve—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――! I-I'm so sorry.
It was lights-out time, wasn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for taking up so much of your time.
E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* ...I lost track of time.
I didn't realize it had gotten this late already.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It should be a dream within reach now.
That's precisely why we must focus on the representative exchange match first."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I have to win against “her”...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, ahead of the Representative Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>.
G-Good morning.
...Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. For the next representative exchange match—
I want to hold back '<chrname>.'"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That's how I intend to run.
Please support me on the day...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With quiet yet unwavering eyes...
she made that declaration.
